test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

There was a sudden esklation of violent acts which led to the starting of the second world war.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"escalation"** refers to a situation in which something becomes greater or more serious over a period of time. (वृद्धि)
 
 
• **Example: **The escalation of the conflict has led to a significant increase in refugees.
 
 
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in the given sentence is **"Esklation"**, which should be correctly spelled as **"escalation"**. (वृद्धि)
 
 
• **Example: **Efforts were made to de-escalate the situation before it led to violence.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the incorrect spelling is **"Esklation"**, which should be "escalation".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Starting** (शुरुआत): The action of beginning something or causing something to begin.
 
 
• **Example:** The starting of the new project is scheduled for next Monday.
 
 
 
• **Violent** (हिंसक): Using or involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The protest turned violent after clashes with the police.
 
 
 
• **Sudden** (अचानक): Occurring or done quickly and unexpectedly or without warning.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a sudden downpour that caught everyone by surprise.
